reuse_ideas: Use as a plant pot, pencil holder, or bird feeder

reuse_ideas: Use for gift wrapping, packing material, or window cleaning

reuse_ideas: Use for storage, moving, or as a cat scratcher/play box

diy_ideas: Build organizers, a cat house, or kids play furniture

reuse_ideas: Use for storing spices, leftovers, or as a drinking glass

recycling_suggestions: Take to an e-waste recycling center; never bin electronics with regular trash
diy_ideas: Use old parts for DIY electronics/robotics projects if you are into tinkering

reuse_ideas: Use as plant labels, a bulletin board, or drawer bumpers

reuse_ideas: Donate to a library or school, or use as home decor

reuse_ideas: Use as a vase, oil dispenser, or decorative light holder

reuse_ideas: Use as a small funnel or for craft beading

reuse_ideas: Use as a small planting pot for seedlings or a paint cup

reuse_ideas: Line small trash bins or wrap fragile items when packing

diy_ideas: Fold into origami boxes for organizing small items

reuse_ideas: Use the bottom half as a small planter with drainage

reuse_ideas: Use as outdoor gardening shoes or donate if still wearable

reuse_ideas: Use as a pen holder, small planter, or storage tin

reuse_ideas: Cut images for scrapbooking, gift tags, or bookmarks

reuse_ideas: Use as a garden planter, swing, or outdoor seating base
